title: Why Buyers and Sellers Trust Eduardo Rodriguez of FYI Yachts
description: Experience trust and passion in yacht brokerage with Eduardo Rodriguez, your expert guide to buying or selling in Miami’s vibrant yachting scene.
html:
Building Trust Through Passion and Experience

For yacht buyers and sellers alike, choosing the right broker is about more than market knowledge. It’s about trust, dedication, and a genuine love for the boating lifestyle. That’s exactly what Eduardo Rodriguez brings to every client relationship. Born in Havana and now thriving in Miami’s vibrant yachting community, Eduardo combines a personal passion for the water with professional expertise to guide clients through one of life’s most exciting investments.

39′ Stamas 2016

A Passion for the Boating Lifestyle

Eduardo has always had a deep appreciation for boats, and since joining FYI Yachts in 2020, he’s fully immersed himself in the “boat life.” From day trips to the Bahamas to enjoying time aboard luxury yachts like the Majesty 140, Eduardo doesn’t just sell the lifestyle—he lives it. For buyers, this means working with someone who truly understands what makes each yacht unique and how it fits into different boating dreams. For sellers, it means he knows how to highlight the details and experiences that resonate with potential buyers.

Closing Deals and Building Relationships

Every great broker has a defining first sale, and for Eduardo, that milestone came with a 2005 Sea Ray Sedan Bridge 420. It wasn’t just about handing over the keys. It was about building confidence, navigating challenges, and ensuring both buyer and seller walked away satisfied. That first deal set the foundation for Eduardo’s philosophy today: focus on relationships, not just transactions. Whether you’re upgrading to your next yacht or listing one for sale, Eduardo brings the same level of dedication to every client he works with.

40′ Sea Ray 2016

Featured Listings with Eduardo Rodriguez

Eduardo is currently representing several standout yachts for sale, each offering something unique for today’s buyers:

  • 40′ Sea Ray 2016 – A versatile express cruiser designed for comfort and performance. Perfect for weekends on the water with family and friends. View Listing →
  • 39′ Stamas 2016 – Built for serious offshore adventures, this Stamas is an ideal choice for fishing enthusiasts who don’t want to compromise on comfort. View Listing →
  • 22′ Sea Ray 2010 – A great entry-level boat for anyone looking to enjoy Miami’s waterways, with an accessible size that makes it easy to handle and enjoy. View Listing →

These listings reflect Eduardo’s ability to work with a range of clients—from first-time buyers to seasoned yachtsmen—ensuring each client finds the perfect fit for their boating lifestyle.

22′ Sea Ray 2010

Why Clients Rely on Eduardo

In an ever-changing industry, Eduardo’s adaptability and professionalism stand out. He believes in making strong first impressions, learning continuously, and staying connected with clients long after a deal is done. Buyers appreciate his ability to match them with the right yacht for their lifestyle, while sellers trust his attention to detail and persistence in getting their yacht in front of the right audience.

Partner with Eduardo Rodriguez

Buying or selling a yacht is a big decision, and having the right broker makes all the difference. Eduardo Rodriguez brings passion, market insight, and a personal connection to every deal he handles at FYI Yachts. Whether you’re ready to find your next yacht or list your current one for sale, Eduardo is here to guide you every step of the way.

Ready to take the next step? Contact Eduardo Rodriguez today at +1 (786) 657-6574 or erodriguez@fyiyachts.com and explore his available listings at FYI Yachts.
